Part II of HeightsRationalPointsAndObstructions for uniform Bogomolov and uniform Mordell–Lang. The title reproduces the parent's atlas title 'Heights, rational points and obstructions' exactly, the area is a galaxy id, and the brief is 423 words that state Theorems 1.1, 1.1′, 1.2 and 1.3 as the paper does and list the imports layer by layer. RP.5 plans the qualitative Mordell–Lang and Bogomolov theorems only, and uniformity in the ambient abelian variety — non-degenerate families over the restricted Hilbert scheme, the DGH height inequality, Kühne's equidistribution, the gap principle and Rémond's quantitative Vojta method — is a new direction rather than a stage of RP.5. The shared id is right: PAPER-DIMITROV-GAO-HABEGGER-21, PAPER-GAO-HABEGGER-19, PAPER-DEMARCO-KRIEGER-YE-20 and PAPER-DEMARCO-MAVRAKI-YE-26 all route to it with this title, and PAPER-YUAN-26 routes to it with the narrower title 'uniform Bogomolov for curves'. The design job should take the broader title, since Theorem 1.3 here contains the number-field curve case, and should treat the Yuan brief as binding for its own statements, which is what this brief says.

notes: Accept, with one correction in place. The recorded hash of the Centre Mersenne PDF reproduces (4ee5a38b…) and I re-extracted all 48 pages; the published pagination is pdf page + 188. Structure: 93 items, all 74 missing items routed exactly once, no source route takes a planned or library item, all eight stage ids and all fifteen planned layer ids exist in data/atlas.json, both Part II parents exist with titles that the proposed titles reproduce exactly, both areas are galaxy ids, and check_paper.py passes. Coverage: the 35 numbered environments I could extract mechanically from the text all appear in items, and so do the unnumbered constructions the proofs turn on (the restricted Hilbert scheme, the difference map D, the Ueno locus). Locators: of 60 name-and-page checks, 55 land on exactly the page given and the other five are proofs that span pages (Lemma 2.4 stated p.196 and finished p.197, Lemma 4.3 stated p.207 and used p.208, Proposition 4.4 stated p.208 and finished p.209, Proposition 5.2 stated p.212 and finished pp.217–218). Statuses: the three Tau Ceti citations are right — TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety (AbelianVariety/Basic.lean:94) is literally 'a proper geometrically integral group scheme over Spec K', InvertibleSheaf (LineBundle/Basic.lean:78) and IsIsogeny (AbelianVariety/Isogeny.lean:61) exist as cited — and their notes say honestly what is not yet there (the Picard-group and translation API, the degree of an isogeny). The correction is item 55: the Weil height on P^n(Qbar) was marked library on Mathlib's Projectivization.logHeight, but that definition needs a Height.AdmissibleAbsValues instance and Mathlib has one only for number fields, so neither the height on P^n(Qbar) nor the induced height on A(Qbar) is in the libraries; the item is now planned at RP.0, which plans exactly that import together with independence of the field extension, and the Mathlib declaration stays in the note as the supplier. All thirteen findings are confirmed, each read at its locator in a clean re-extraction (the journal PDF hides its fonts in object streams, so a naive extraction loses every relation symbol; with the streams expanded, E3 and E13 are indeed printed with a strict '<'). E2 needed Lemma 2.4's constant 4^{dim Y + dim Y'}, which gives 16^r rather than the printed 8^r; E6 and E7 needed the definitions of D and of Lemma 4.3, which fix the block count m(M+1) and the box power L_s^{⊠m(M+2)}; E9 and E10 needed (Hyp pack) on p.220, which bounds by c_0^{rk Γ+1} and uses the threshold c_0^{-1} max{1, h_Fal(A)}; and E12, the one gap, is real: the induction in §8 applies Theorem 1.3 and Proposition 5.1 to components that need not generate the ambient abelian variety and sit in translates, and the recorded repair through X_i − P_1 ⊆ B_i, Lemma 2.5 and the parallelogram law is sound. Nothing else was corrected, rejected or deleted, and no finding was added: I read §§1–2, 4.3, 5.2, 6–8 and Appendix A.5 around the findings and the statements of every result the routes cite, not all 47 pages line by line.
